title: Comparable cost per completed job
method: Synthetic monthly costs and completed jobs: A=12,000/600,000=0.020; B=9,000/300,000=0.030; C=15,000/1,000,000=0.015. Common currency, scope and quality are assumed. No vendor ranking or customer outcome is implied.
alt: Comparable cost per completed job. Deployment A: 0.02 currency units per job; Deployment B: 0.03 currency units per job; Deployment C: 0.015 currency units per job. Illustrative values.
